record.name: Ecwid
record.one_liner: Ecwid is an ecommerce platform that enables businesses to build online stores and integrate with APIs for managing products, orders, and customers.
record.access_note: Only stores on paid plans can access API, though free upgrades can be requested for development.
record.api_note: The API covers products, categories, orders, customers, and other store data via REST endpoints.
record.blocker_note: API access requires a paid plan, though developers can request a free upgrade for test stores under specific conditions.

evidence.quote: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
Only stores on paid plans can access API.
All requests to Ecwid REST API require an access token.
